title: Kent Selin sees flux liner over Edwards
summary: UAPGerb tells of Kent Selin sees flux liner over Edwards, about 1970s at Edwards Air Force Base, California, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He talked to an individual named Kent Selin who said he saw this over Edwards Air Force Base in the 70s.

plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb says that a man named Mark McCandlish talked to a man named Kent Selin, who said he saw a particular kind of craft, called a flux liner, over Edwards Air Force Base in California in the 1970s. UAPGerb tells it because, if true, it would mean such an advanced craft was flying over a US military base decades ago.
